sql.if: and (ec.certification_name ilike concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or ec.certification_code ilike concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or exists (select 1 from cm_syllabus_version sv where sv.certification_id = ec.id and sv.version_name ilike concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')))

mapper.select: select ec.id, ec.certification_code, ec.certification_name, ec.qualification_level, ec.status, ec.sort_order, ec.create_time, ec.update_time from cm_exam_certification ec where 1=1 order by ec.sort_order asc, ec.certification_name asc, ec.id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from cm_exam_certification ec where 1=1

select sv.id, sv.certification_id, sv.version_name, sv.published_date, sv.create_time, sv.update_time from cm_syllabus_version sv where sv.certification_id in #{id} order by sv.certification_id, sv.published_date desc nulls last, sv.create_time desc, sv.id desc
select id, certification_code, certification_name, qualification_level, status, sort_order, create_time, update_time from cm_exam_certification where id=#{id}
select id, certification_code, certification_name, qualification_level, status, sort_order, create_time, update_time from cm_exam_certification where id=#{id} for update
select id from cm_exam_certification where lower(certification_code) = lower(#{code}) and id <> #{excludeId} limit 1
select id from cm_exam_certification where lower(certification_name) = lower(#{name}) and id <> #{excludeId} limit 1
select id, certification_id, version_name, published_date, create_time, update_time from cm_syllabus_version where id=#{id} and certification_id=#{certificationId}
select id, certification_id, version_name, published_date, create_time, update_time from cm_syllabus_version where id=#{id} and certification_id=#{certificationId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into cm_exam_certification(id, certification_code, certification_name, qualification_level, status, sort_order, create_by, create_dept, update_by) values(#{id},#{code},#{name},#{level},#{status},#{sortOrder},#{userId},#{deptId},#{userId})
insert into cm_exam_subject(id, certification_id, subject_code, subject_name, create_by, update_by) values(#{id},#{certificationId},#{code},#{name},#{userId},#{userId})
mapper.update: update cm_exam_certification set certification_code=#{code}, certification_name=#{name}, qualification_level=#{level}, status=#{status}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, update_by=#{userId}, update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select set_config('certmuse.qualification_cascade_delete', case when #{enabled} then 'on' else 'off' end, true)
mapper.insert: insert into cm_syllabus_version(id, certification_id, version_name, published_date, create_by, create_dept, update_by) values(#{id},#{certificationId},#{name},#{publishedDate},#{userId},#{deptId},#{userId})
mapper.update: update cm_syllabus_version set version_name=#{name}, published_date=#{publishedDate}, update_by=#{userId}, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and certification_id=#{certificationId}
mapper.delete: delete from cm_syllabus_version where id=#{id} and certification_id=#{certificationId}
mapper.select: select distinct image.storage_path from cm_document_image image join cm_document_chunk chunk on chunk.id=image.chunk_id join cm_document document on document.id=chunk.document_id where document.syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId} and coalesce(trim(image.storage_path), '') <> ''

select distinct storage_path from ( select image.storage_path from cm_document_image image join cm_document_chunk chunk on chunk.id=image.chunk_id join cm_document document on document.id=chunk.document_id left join cm_syllabus_version version on version.id=document.syllabus_version_id where document.certification_id=#{certificationId} or version.certification_id=#{certificationId} union select image.storage_path from cm_question_image image join cm_question_revision revision on revision.id=image.question_revision_id join cm_question question on question.id=revision.question_id join cm_exam_subject subject on subject.id=question.exam_subject_id where subject.certification_id=#{certificationId} ) storage_objects where coalesce(trim(storage_path), '') <> ''
select (select count(*) from cm_document_image where storage_path=#{objectKey}) + (select count(*) from cm_question_image where storage_path=#{objectKey})

select type, label, reference_count as "count" from (values ('USER_GOAL','用户目标',(select count(*) from cm_user_goal where certification_id=#{id})), ('EXAM_SCHEDULE','考试安排',(select count(*) from cm_exam_schedule where certification_id=#{id})), ('COLLECTION','题集',(select count(*) from cm_collection where certification_id=#{id})), ('QUESTION','题目',(select count(*) from cm_question q join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id where es.certification_id=#{id} and q.del_flag='0')), ('KNOWLEDGE_POINT','知识点',(select count(*) from cm_knowledge_point kp join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=kp.syllabus_version_id where sv.certification_id=#{id} and kp.del_flag='0')), ('TEXTBOOK','教材',(select count(*) from cm_document d join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=d.syllabus_version_id where sv.certification_id=#{id} and d.document_type='textbook' and d.del_flag='0')) ) as blockers(type,label,reference_count) where reference_count > 0

select type, label, reference_count as "count" from (values ('KNOWLEDGE_POINT','知识点',(select count(*) from cm_knowledge_point where syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('KNOWLEDGE_PREREQUISITE','知识点前置关系',(select count(*) from cm_knowledge_prerequisite where syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('TEXTBOOK','教材',(select count(*) from cm_document where syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('IMPORT_BATCH','导入批次',(select count(*) from cm_import_batch where syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('USER_GOAL','用户目标',(select count(*) from cm_user_goal where syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('COLLECTION','题集',(select count(*) from cm_collection where syllabus_version_id=#{id})) ) as blockers(type,label,reference_count) where reference_count > 0

select type,label,reference_count as "count" from (values ('QUESTION','题目',(select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where kp.syllabus_version_id=#{id})), ('TEXTBOOK','教材',(select count(*) from cm_document where syllabus_version_id=#{id})) ) as blockers(type,label,reference_count) where reference_count > 0
select payload_hash, status, resource_id, response_status, cast(response_body as text) response_body from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{action} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_id=#{resourceId},response_status=200,response_body=cast(#{responseBody} as jsonb),update_time=now() where action_code=#{action} and request_id=#{requestId}
